Here's what the search turned up. The main event is a March 2026 federal indictment, with later follow-ups.

- **The charges:** Federal prosecutors in Manhattan charged Super Micro co-founder Yih-Shyan "Wally" Liaw, Taiwan sales manager Ruei-Tsang "Steven" Chang, and contractor Ting-Wei "Willy" Sun. They were charged with conspiring to violate export control laws, smuggling goods from the US and conspiring to defraud the US. Supermicro itself was not named, but the company confirmed the roles of the three individuals.
- **The alleged scheme:** The men allegedly used a pass-through company based in Southeast Asia to place orders to obscure that the servers would end up in China. To deceive the manufacturer's auditors, they allegedly used dummy nonworking copies of the servers while the actual servers were on their way to China. The indictment puts the scale at roughly $2.5 billion worth of servers sold to a Southeast Asian company, which allegedly sent $510 million worth of servers with banned chips to final destinations in China.
- **Company response:** Supermicro said the conduct alleged is a contravention of the company's policies and compliance controls. An independent internal probe later concluded the company's current senior management had no knowledge of the scheme. Liaw resigned from the board.
- **Market reaction:** Shares of Supermicro fell 25% after the indictment was announced, CNBC reported.
- **Later developments:** One less-established source (tech-insider.org) reports that federal prosecutors filed criminal charges against two former logistics managers for allegedly facilitating the export of Nvidia AI chips to China-linked entities. I could not confirm this in a more authoritative outlet, so treat it cautiously.
- **Prior history:** Fortune reports that BIS previously charged the company with three counts of selling goods knowing that export violations would occur and three counts of misrepresenting its shipper export declarations.

Caveat: the search results come from news outlets and some low-quality sites, and I did not check court documents or any DOJ press release directly. The charges are allegations, and I found no result reporting a verdict.

Tuesday's Report Has One Number Left.","url":"https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/10/super-micro-already-told-us-its-revenue-its-margin/"},{"title":"SUPER MICRO COMPUTER INC (SMCI.MX) Q4 FY2026 earnings call transcript","url":"https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/SMCI.MX/earnings/SMCI.MX-Q4-2026-earnings_call-660964.html"},{"title":"SMCI Q4 FY2026 Earnings: AI Server Demand, Margins and Supermicro Stock","url":"https://www.mexc.com/crypto-pulse/article/smci-q4-fy2026-earnings-138149"},{"title":"Supermicro (SMCI) Q4 2026 Earnings Call Transcript and Summary","url":"https://gloom.sh/stocks/smci/transcripts/q4-2026"},{"title":"Super Micro Q4 FY2026: gross margin doubled, and the year burned $6.8 billion — Tradune","url":"https://tradune.com/earnings/super-micro-q4-fy2026/"}]

The search confirms the 17.5% figure and the main explanation, which was mostly customer and product mix.

- **The number:** Supermicro's GAAP gross margin for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 was 17.5%, versus 9.9% in Q3 and 9.5% a year earlier. The non-GAAP figure was 17.6% (Gross margin of 17.5% versus 9.9% in Q3'26 and 9.5% in Q4'25.; Non-GAAP gross margin of 17.6% versus 9.6% in Q4'25.).
- **Beat vs. guidance:** The company had guided to a non-GAAP margin of 8.2% to 8.4%, so the result landed far above that range (Q4 non-GAAP gross margin was 17.6% versus our guidance of 8.2% to 8.4%.). The July preliminary update had signaled 15% to 17%, and the final number came in above that range (Gross margin exceeded Supermicro's preliminary 15%–17% range.).
- **Management's explanation:** The 750-basis-point sequential gain was mainly attributed to mix. The improvement reflected a better-than-anticipated customer and product mix, including the deferral of several contracts from Q4 fiscal year '26 to Q1 fiscal year '27, and perhaps the subsequent quarter. Mix accounted for about three-quarters of the gain, while lower tariff costs and lower inventory reserves drove the remaining 25% of the gross margin improvement.
- **Analyst skepticism:** One Motley Fool piece framed the question as whether the quarter was a reset or a one-off. It argued that an outlook built on gross margins holding near the mid-teens says the fourth quarter was a reset in the business's economics, while one built on single-digit margins says the fourth quarter's margin was a one-off. Another source noted that management characterized tariff and inventory benefits as potentially non-recurring.
- **Forward guidance:** Management guided the September quarter to a gross margin in the range of 10.4%-10.8%, far below the Q4 level.
- **Outcome check:** The later Q1 FY2027 release reported a gross margin of 12.7% versus 17.5% in Q4'26 and 9.3% in Q1'26. That supports the view that Q4 was not a sustained run-rate.

The search turned up FY2026 10-K figures for operating cash flow and related-party balances, but nothing on an SEC investigation.

- **Operating cash flow:** Supermicro reported a FY2026 operating cash outflow of about $6.8 billion, against roughly $1.66 billion of inflow in FY2025 (index 3-6, 5-10). One analysis put the gap in context: net income was about $2.2 billion, so cash lagged earnings sharply (5-4).
- **Working capital drivers:** One summary attributes about $8.9 billion of the cash use to inventory growth and about $3.9 billion to accounts receivable growth (5-11). Receivables were about $6.1 billion at year-end (3-4).
- **Receivables and related parties:** The cash flow statement's receivables line includes related-party balance changes of $(231) thousand in FY2026, $5,801 thousand in FY2025, and $(721) thousand in FY2024 (1-2). The related-party change in receivables was therefore immaterial in FY2026 compared with the total swing.
- **Ablecom and Compuware:** Purchases from Ablecom totaled $390.5 million in FY2026, and amounts Supermicro owed Ablecom were $64.3 million at June 30, 2026 (2-10, 2-11). Combined purchases from both affiliates were 2.1% of cost of sales in FY2026, down from 3.3% in FY2025 (6-6). Ablecom owns about 15% of Compuware, and Charles Liang and Sara Liu together hold about 10.5% of Ablecom (2-3, 2-4).
- **Investigation:** One source mentions an outside-counsel review led by the lead independent director and audit committee chair, which found no evidence that current senior management knew of the alleged misconduct (3-1). I found no source confirming an SEC investigation, so it needs a separate search.

Super Micro Computer, Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2026
Financial analysis of Super Micro Computer, fiscal 2026

results:
The search turned up FY2026 10-K figures for operating cash flow and related-party balances, but nothing on an SEC investigation.

- **Operating cash flow:** Supermicro reported a FY2026 operating cash outflow of about $6.8 billion, against roughly $1.66 billion of inflow in FY2025 (index 3-6, 5-10). One analysis put the gap in context: net income was about $2.2 billion, so cash lagged earnings sharply (5-4).
- **Working capital drivers:** One summary attributes about $8.9 billion of the cash use to inventory growth and about $3.9 billion to accounts receivable growth (5-11). Receivables were about $6.1 billion at year-end (3-4).
- **Receivables and related parties:** The cash flow statement's receivables line includes related-party balance changes of $(231) thousand in FY2026, $5,801 thousand in FY2025, and $(721) thousand in FY2024 (1-2). The related-party change in receivables was therefore immaterial in FY2026 compared with the total swing.
- **Ablecom and Compuware:** Purchases from Ablecom totaled $390.5 million in FY2026, and amounts Supermicro owed Ablecom were $64.3 million at June 30, 2026 (2-10, 2-11). Combined purchases from both affiliates were 2.1% of cost of sales in FY2026, down from 3.3% in FY2025 (6-6). Ablecom owns about 15% of Compuware, and Charles Liang and Sara Liu together hold about 10.5% of Ablecom (2-3, 2-4).
- **Investigation:** One source mentions an outside-counsel review led by the lead independent director and audit committee chair, which found no evidence that current senior management knew of the alleged misconduct (3-1). I found no source confirming an SEC investigation, so it needs a separate search.

Primary source: the FY2026 10-K on SEC EDGAR (smci-20260630.htm), which has the full cash flow statement and Note 11 on related parties.

我給 **62 / 100 分，屬於偏高風險**。這是我依公開資訊做的主觀判斷，不是量化模型的結果，也不代表財報確定有錯。意思是：這份財報被重大誤述的機率，明顯高於一般大型美國上市公司（我估一般公司約 15–25 分），但目前沒有證據顯示已經發生重大誤述。 **背景事實**：FY2026 會計年度截至 2026/6/30，10-K 在 2026/8/31 申報。全年營收 391 億美元（FY2025 為 220 億）。會計師對財報出具無保留意見，但對內部控制出具否定意見，這已經是連續第三年。 ## 拉高分數的因素 | 因素 | 說明 | 影響 | |---|---|---| | **1. 內控連續三年被判無效** | 截至 2026/6/30，仍有一項重大缺失：資訊系統的使用者權限沒有被持續且及時監控。FY2025 的另外三項重大缺失已改善。權限管控不好，代表系統裡的資料可能被不當修改卻沒人發現，所以財報數字比較需要靠會計師額外查核來確認。 | 高 | | **2. 公司過去的紀錄** | 2020 年因提前認列營收和費用分類問題，與 SEC 和解。2024 年 Hindenburg 發布放空報告，原會計師 EY 辭任，之後才換成現任會計師（10-K 寫「自 2024 年起擔任」，第三方資料顯示是 BDO，我未從原文確認）。這類紀錄通常代表管理層會為了達成業績而在會計上動手腳的風險較高。 | 高 | | **3. 2026 年 3 月的出口管制起訴案** | 共同創辦人 Wally Liaw 等三人被控把約 25 億美元的伺服器賣給一家東南亞中間商，其中約 5.1 億美元流向中國，還用不能運作的假機器應付稽核。這直接牽涉到幾個帳務問題：
• 這些營收的客戶是否真實，交易是否有商業實質
• 是否可能被罰款，罰款要估多少並先列帳（或有負債）
• 銷售流程的內控是否被高層繞過
內部調查認定現任高層不知情，但這是公司自己委託的調查，獨立性有限。 | 高 | | **4. 獲利和現金流嚴重背離** | 全年淨利約 22 億美元，營業現金流卻是**流出約 68 億美元**。依第三方摘要，存貨增加約 89 億，應收帳款增加約 39 億，年底應收帳款約 61 億。這會讓兩個地方的判斷空間變大：存貨要提多少跌價準備，營收要在哪個時點認列（例如貨出了但還沒驗收）。 | 中高 | | **5. Q4 毛利率突然跳升** | Q4 毛利率 17.5%，遠高於公司自己的指引 8.2–8.4%，也高於 7 月初步預告的 15–17%。管理層說約四分之三來自產品與客戶組合，剩下四分之一來自關稅成本下降和**存貨準備減少**。剛好在年底大幅調降存貨準備，是查核時會特別盯的典型風險。下一季（Q1 FY27）毛利率回到 12.7%，代表 Q4 確實是一次性的。 | 中 | | **6. 關係人交易** | 向 Ablecom、Compuware 採購的金額占銷貨成本約 2.1%（FY2025 為 3.3%）。這兩家都與創辦人 Charles Liang 夫婦有持股關係。金額不大，但屬於長期存在的關注點。 | 低至中 | ## 拉低分數的因素 - **會計師出具無保留意見**，而且明知內控無效，仍給出財報數字公允的結論。內控被判無效時，會計師照規定必須擴大實質查核範圍。 - **剩下的缺失性質較窄**：只是權限監控問題，不是營收認列或期末結帳本身出錯，也沒有因此發現需要更正的數字。另外三項缺失已經改善。 - **事後數字有對上**：Q1 FY27 的毛利率回到正常水準，與管理層「Q4 是組合因素造成」的說法一致。目前沒有看到財報重編或延遲申報。 - **主要客戶付款能力強**：大部分客戶是大型雲端與 AI 業者，應收帳款收不回來的風險相對低。 ## 綜合判斷 - 基準分約 20，前述六項因素合計加約 50 分。 - 減項約 10 分：無保留意見，加上剩下的缺失範圍窄。 - 結果約 **62 分**。 風險最集中在三處： 1. **出口管制相關**：涉案營收的認列，以及罰款要估多少並先列帳。 2. **存貨**：存貨的價值有沒有高估，以及 Q4 調降的存貨準備是否合理。 3. **營收截止**：年底大量出貨、貨物運送中或還在等客戶驗收時，營收是否記在正確的年度。 ## 會讓我調整分數的情況 - **調升到 75 分以上**：DOJ 或 SEC 把公司本身列為調查對象；會計師辭任，或查核報告加註強調事項；財報需要重編；FY27 應收帳款持續比營收增加得快。 - **調降到 45 分以下**：FY27 內控缺失全部改善；營業現金流轉正，存貨開始減少；出口案在罰款金額有限的情況下和解。 **資料限制**：部分數字來自第三方摘要網站，我沒有逐項核對 10-K 原文，包括存貨和應收帳款的變動、會計師名稱、關係人採購金額。我也沒有找到確認 SEC 目前正在調查公司的消息。 Sources: -
